name: nested_for_in_function
source:
{ A nested FOR inside a FUNCTION body must execute, not be silently dropped.
  Java nestedForInsideFunctionAccumulatesCorrectly: the double sum of i*j over
  i, j = 1..3 is 36. }
FUNCTION DoubleSum(n)
  s := 0
  FOR i = 1 TO n
    FOR j = 1 TO n
      s = s + i * j
    END
  END
  DoubleSum := s
END

x = DoubleSum(3)
